summary: This bill amends the Controlled Substances Act to permanently classify 2-benzylbenzimidazole opioids, commonly known as nitazenes, as Schedule I controlled substances, making their possession, manufacture, and distribution illegal under federal law.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on drug policy, specifically by permanently scheduling 2-benzylbenzimidazole opioids (nitazenes) as Schedule I controlled substances. This action makes the enforcement of drug laws stricter for these substances.

By permanently classifying nitazenes as Schedule I controlled substances, the bill strengthens the legal framework for prosecuting offenses related to these drugs, thereby contributing to stricter justice and stronger policing in drug enforcement.
